The decline is concentrated after first top-up, so investigate the top-up-to-activation journey; the available data does not identify a specific cause.","supporting_metrics":[{"name":"organic activation rate","baseline_value":0.420664,"anomaly_value":0.394461,"unit":"fraction","sql":"SELECT signup_month, SUM(n_activated)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) FROM agg_funnel_monthly WHERE channel='organic' AND signup_month IN (TIMESTAMP '2026-03-01', TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01') GROUP BY 1"},{"name":"organic sign-ups","baseline_value":2981,"anomaly_value":2961,"unit":"count","sql":"SELECT signup_month, SUM(n_signups) FROM agg_funnel_monthly WHERE channel='organic' AND signup_month IN (TIMESTAMP '2026-03-01', TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01') GROUP BY 1"},{"name":"organic top-up rate","baseline_value":0.467964,"anomaly_value":0.454914,"unit":"fraction","sql":"SELECT signup_month, SUM(n_first_topup)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) FROM agg_funnel_monthly WHERE channel='organic' AND signup_month IN (TIMESTAMP '2026-03-01', TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01') GROUP BY 1"},{"name":"organic KYC approval rate","baseline_value":0.635357,"anomaly_value":0.636947,"unit":"fraction","sql":"SELECT signup_month, SUM(n_kyc_approved)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) FROM agg_funnel_monthly WHERE channel='organic' AND signup_month IN (TIMESTAMP '2026-03-01', TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01') GROUP BY 1"},{"name":"organic activation rate comparison (two-proportion test)","baseline_value":0.4207,"anomaly_value":0.3945,"unit":"fraction","sql":"calculate_uplift_or_stats: two_proportion_test (March k=1254,n=2981; April k=1168,n=2961); delta -2.62 pp, 95% CI [-5.12,-0.12], p=0.0399"}],"recommended_action":"NO_ACTION_NOISE","reasoning_summary":"Activation moved from 0.4207 in March to 0.3945 in April among roughly 3,000 organic sign-ups per month; the two-proportion test gives a -2.62 pp change (95% CI -5.12 to -0.12, p=0.0399). However, April's 0.3945 rate is within the range of prior observed monthly organic rates, including 0.3719 in December 2025 and 0.3919 in January 2026, so this is not enough evidence of a new break. Upstream funnel rates are stable, with top-up-to-activation worth further monitoring rather than treating this as a confirmed onboarding incident."}
